title: S12T02 - Centralize child process timeouts and output caps
description: MCP, console live-data, and SQLite helpers spawn child processes and collect stdout/stderr without one shared timeout and byte-cap contract.
acceptanceCriteria: A shared runner enforces command-specific timeout, stdout/stderr byte caps, kill cleanup, and structured truncation/timeout errors.
Tests cover timeout, stdout overflow, stderr overflow, non-JSON payloads, and killed process cleanup.
closedReason: Bounded child-process runner implemented and verified
